source: 上外版选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 同主题完形(立志做科学家/参观科技馆/科学需要每个人/太空动物/霍金的精神/发现的乐趣)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词，每篇10空，选项同词性、无双解，与阅读/听力关不撞。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: Becoming a Scientist
passages.text: When I was young, I was already very (1)____ about how the world works. I would spend hours (2)____ insects in the garden and asking endless questions. My parents were always (3)____ and bought me my first science book. After reading it, I felt (4)____ to learn much more. At school, my favourite (5)____ was biology, because it explained how living things grow. My teacher told us that a good scientist must stay (6)____ and never stop wondering. She also said that every great (7)____ began with a simple question. Slowly, I made up my mind to (8)____ science at university one day. I know the road ahead will be (9)____, but I am ready to work hard. In the future, I hope my own research will (10)____ many other people.

passages.title: Why Science Needs Everyone
passages.text: For a long time, science was seen as a (1)____ only for men. Many talented women were not (2)____ the same chances as men. Some were not even (3)____ to join important discussions. passages.title: Animals in Space
passages.text: The first living things to travel into space were not people but (1)____. In the 1950s, scientists sent two monkeys high above the Earth. passages.title: Stephen Hawking's Spirit
passages.text: Stephen Hawking was one of the greatest scientists of our (1)____. At the age of twenty-one, he was told that he had a serious (2)____. passages.title: The Joy of Discovery
